## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden. She is also fair with golden hair, occasionally seen dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant possesses a lively personality. She is known for being full of mischief, pranks, and a sense of fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- full to the brim of mischief and pranks and fun  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and was the niece of author Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). During a spring picnic walk, Priscilla joined her friends in naming [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake) and poeticizing nature while exploring [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden. She later surprised [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by bringing Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for an unexpected visit. Priscilla reunited with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), taking her to their boardinghouse before registering together at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). The two girls met [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) in Old St.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), +39 more_

## Quotes

> "It would be too good to be true. Fairy tales don’t happen nowadays. I won’t hope, Anne. The disappointment would be too awful to bear. They’re sure to want more for it than we can afford. Remember, it’s on Spofford Avenue."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Friend P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031)

> "This cake is now what you might call a flat failure. And the cushion is likewise ruined. Never tell me that Friday isn’t unlucky."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P35](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0035)

> “Little did I think the day would ever come when I’d be glad of the sight of a Sloane,” said Priscilla, as they crossed the campus, “but I’d welcome Charlie’s goggle eyes almost ecstatically. At least, they’d be familiar eyes.”
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004)

> "She talks as much about boys as Ruby Gillis does. But it always enrages or sickens me to hear Ruby, whereas I just wanted to laugh good-naturedly at Phil. Now, what is the why of that?"
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070)

> "Here you are, beloved! And I suppose you’re as tired as I was when I got here Saturday night."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Farewell P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became close friends while studying together at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their bond includes social visits and shared outdoor outings, such as a spring picnic where they poetically discussed nature and soul imagery. Priscilla also visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) accompanied by her aunt, and warmly welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) by escorting her to their boardinghouse and lifting her spirits.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), +32 more_

- Friend of — close friend at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are companions who share social outings through their mutual friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). ### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phil-gordon--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) are close college friends who met at Old St. John's Cemetery during their registration period at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
